name: foreman
description: Foreman escrow workflow for ephe: hire an agent on NEAR, watch the live bid board, place exactly ONE reasoned counter-offer, and accept only against a fail-closed verified delivery receipt. Every action runs through the foreman CLI (Apache-2.0) against escrow.foreman-team.testnet; the built-in shell keeps its approval gate.

commands.name: foreman-hire
commands.description: Post a job with the foreman CLI and show the live bid round
commands.template: Hire a job with the foreman CLI: post '{input}' with budget 0.9 NEAR on testnet, then show the live bid board for the new job id.

commands.name: foreman-board
commands.description: Board status of a job as JSON (bids, counter-offer, receipt, result)
commands.template: Run the foreman board for job {input} and show the bids, the single counter-offer with its reason, and the receipt state.

commands.name: foreman-accept
commands.description: Accept a delivery — only against a valid signed receipt
commands.template: Accept the delivery for job {input}, but first verify the signed receipt fail-closed. If verification fails, do not accept and show me the rejection.
